mood.label: Pocket-Sized Welcome
mood.summary: An easy neighborhood stroll with pockets of quiet and a little lift when two paper animals meet.

storyteller.quirk: Leaves a beat of quiet each time the paper bird peeks out.

kid_older.quirk: Sounds gently delighted whenever a familiar thing turns into a paper animal.

kid_younger.quirk: Lets the word ‘peek’ come out in a tiny rising lilt.

art.style_prompt_prefix: Original Giggle & Snooze character design: expressive asymmetric poses, rounded bean and crescent shapes, warm playful faces, a small visual joke and a calm cosy atmosphere. Clean contemporary shapes, generous breathing room, one clear story action. Simplify hair, clothing and scenery into broad shapes; include only story-relevant props. Modern comic-strip cartoons with springy ink contours, expressive eyebrows and flat cheerful colours on clean backgrounds.
art.line: Confident dark rounded outlines with a few lively interior strokes; no crosshatching.
art.lighting: Flat colour with one small graphic shadow; no gradients.
art.composition: Playful asymmetry, expressive full-body gestures and broad uncluttered scenery; no panels or speech bubbles.
avoid: aged paper, sepia washes and vintage styling
heavy brush texture, grain and crosshatching
individual fur strands and intricate clothing detail
existing franchise characters or imitation of an artist

qa.intro_hook: Something pointy is peeking out of Mina’s pocket. Can you spot it?
qa.outro_hook: If a paper animal could say hello for you, which animal would you choose?

kid_notes.kid_older: After a quiet beat at the frog’s wave, offer one possible meaning.
kid_notes.kid_younger: Answer with a word or a small wave. A quiet thought counts, too.

sound.music_direction: Use sparse felt piano in an easy walking rhythm. Leave a quiet beat for Mina’s first peek and add two soft answering notes when the frog waves. Keep the score well below the voices.

rationale: On a lilac sidewalk, Mina’s bean-shaped raincoat frames an oversized cobalt pocket. The yellow bird’s beak briefly catches on the seam before a squat green frog waves back. Carry the same silhouettes, palette, ink contours and flat shadows through both covers. Keep motion to the peek, the wave and relaxed stroller rolls.
